comments: Multivariate approach captures pleiotropic architecture of CKM syndrome; tissue/pathway enrichment and PRS insights support precision medicine targeting.

comments: Large-scale temporal analysis (45M hospital stays, 8.9M patients, 1997–2014) reveals age-dependent network restructuring; absence of geographic signal challenges universality of current disease definitions.
